pages.title: Do Not Let Go
pages.text: Grapple yourself to a block or pull an eligible target with an Undying Tentacle.

pages.title: Do Not Let Go
pages.text: Use an earned trophy for actual target-dependent grappling.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Earn the trophy from the real Kraken. The target selects the function: a block pulls the player, an entity is pulled toward the player. Native movement restrictions remain.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The tentacle has two target-dependent functions, not one generic right-click effect.
